order: This one runs through the cross-vendor lane instead of the usual track. Pair an order with the account of the cross-vendor pass reviewing the round 2 diff, and bound both by the commit pair anchoring the initial round through the round two fixes. What the audit covers stops at that pair and never reaches back beyond it, but the call must be unambiguous, and the verdict on that anchoring pair settles, outright, whether the two open work orders leave revise status. There is no middle reading of the diff that can stand in for that single call, because this cross-vendor pass is the gate the earlier rounds were building toward all along. Put both documents into the roster directory, and treat them as material that did not exist before this pass. The pass alters only those two files, while the rest stays put.
claims: The pass brings one hundred thirty-six new lines into the roster directory, and touches nothing outside it in the tree. Two files that did not exist before now carry that sum, the order holding sixty-five of them and the account seventy-one, while the rest of the directory stays untouched. The commit pair covered anchors the initial round through the round two fixes, and the review ran through the cross-vendor lane. The account closes on the same point, since this single verdict settles, outright, whether the two open work orders leave revise status.
